sentences.text:
Author: Sharad Kumar Sharma
Bench: Sharad Kumar Sharma
 Office Notes, reports,
 orders or proceedings
Sl.
 Date or directions and Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No  Registrar's order with  Signatures  22.03.2023  C482 No. 470 of 2023  Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. P.C. Petshali, Advocate, along with Mr. Yogesh Upadhyay, Advocate, for the applicant.
Mr. Pankaj Joshi, Brief Holder, for the State.

The learned counsel for the applicant argues, that no offence under Sections 269 and 270 of IPC is made out, for which the applicant has been tried by way of Criminal Case No. 2874 of 2022, State Vs. Vipin Bhardwaj & Another, which has emanated from the FIR No. 173 of 2021, registered at P.S.
Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar on 06.05.2021.

But, apparently, looking to the FIR and the Chargesheet itself, the element of Section 420 of IPC,
could be said to be established against the present applicant.
Before considering the Stay Application, it would be apt, that the learned Government Advocate may file his counter affidavit to the present C482 Application.
He may file his counter affidavit within a period of two weeks from today.
List as soon as the counter affidavit is filed by the learned Government Advocate.

(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 22.03.2023 Mahinder/
C482/470/2023 on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48677815/
